items.binding_constraint: The 64 KiB byte limit itself is NOT binding: structurally larger candidates (e.g. 200 params + 254 extra filters + 256x60-char tags = 56726 bytes; 250 params + 250 filters at any tag size) are rejected by the parser budgets (max_total_scalar_bytes 32 KiB in strict_v1_options, max_nodes 4096 / max_events 8192 in crates/ugoite-domain/src/composition/yaml.rs). 54266 bytes was the largest valid combination found in the searched grid; it is near-maximum-valid, not near-65536.
